parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the China (Shanghai) region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: Landmark
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return facial landmark localization results. Valid values: true and false.

parameters.name: MaxFaceNumber
parameters.description: The maximum number of faces to return in the image. Valid values: 1 to 30. Set this parameter correctly if you want to return multiple face detection results. Results are sorted in descending order by the FaceProbabilityList parameter by default.

parameters.name: Pose
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return face pose information. Valid values: true and false.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Specifies whether to return face quality information. Valid values: true and false.
